task: #505 item 1: the seven kube-apiserver --oidc-* flags exist only in each master's static pod manifest (#500), not in the kube-system/kubeadm-config ClusterConfiguration, so kubeadm upgrade apply|node (and a later control-plane join) would regenerate the manifest without OIDC. Persist the flags in ClusterConfiguration.apiServer.extraArgs, fail closed, gate it in verify-cluster.sh and document the post-upgrade check. No cluster is available; live verification is listed, not claimed.

events.summary: Add one helper (11-4c-kubeadm-config-oidc.sh) that merges the seven oidc-* entries into apiServer.extraArgs of the kubeadm-config ClusterConfiguration and patches only data.ClusterConfiguration; call it once from 11-4 (hard fail) and from the Kakao master-1 step of apply-apiserver-oidc-kakao.sh; add a verify-cluster.sh gate, the upgrade runbook note, R297 and two #500 LOW follow-ups (R290b flag-mismatch case, a corrected never-two-masters-down comment). Deliberately left alone: 02-init-cluster.sh (Keycloak does not exist at init), the static pod manifests and 11-4b (it stays their only writer), any live object, extraVolumes (the CA sits under the pki directory kubeadm already mounts), and the other #505 items (portal 1.1.5, Trivy paging, Falco, valkey/kong). Added after review: 02-join-control-plane.sh and distribute-join-kakao.sh install/stage oidc-ca.crt before a later control-plane join.

Issue #505 item 1 records that on Kakao the ClusterConfiguration contains no oidc key (checked 2026-10-28) while 11-4b writes the flags only into the manifest, and kubeadm upgrade regenerates the manifest from ClusterConfiguration. On origin/main 9cc10604 grep -rn 'kubeadm-config' scripts/cluster/11-4*.sh finds no writer of the flags to the ConfigMap, and 02-init-cluster.sh keeps the oidc extraArgs commented out.

events.provenance: two sources: the repo's own 02-init-cluster.sh, which already renders kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta4 with apiServer.extraArgs as a list of {name, value} (used by the implementation lane, which did not read the reference page), and the kubeadm v1beta4 API reference https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/config-api/kubeadm-config.v1beta4/ fetched by the coordinator on 2026-10-31: Arg = {name (required), value (required)}; ControlPlaneComponent.extraArgs is []Arg, 'Extra arguments will override existing default arguments. Duplicate extra arguments are allowed.'; extraVolumes is []HostPathMount
events.summary: 02-init-cluster.sh uses the list form for the apiserver already, so the helper merges into that list, replaces oidc-* entries and also handles a v1beta3 map; any other apiVersion or shape is refused. That a missing --oidc-ca-file is an apiserver startup error comes from the PR review (pkg/kubeapiserver/options/authentication.go), not from a local run.

scripts/cluster/11-4c-kubeadm-config-oidc.sh reads data.ClusterConfiguration and resourceVersion, refuses unparsable input, an unknown kind or apiVersion, two documents and an unexpected extraArgs shape, replaces only oidc-* entries with the seven flags, proves the merge changed nothing else, backs the original up, patches data.ClusterConfiguration only (pinned to the read resourceVersion), re-reads and requires exactly the seven flags. It refuses to write when a readable local apiserver manifest has no volumeMount covering /etc/kubernetes/pki. 11-4 calls it once and exits 1 on failure; apply-apiserver-oidc-kakao.sh checks it is staged before the first restart and runs it on master-1; verify-cluster.sh compares the ClusterConfiguration flags with the expected seven. R290b gains a flag-mismatch case and the apply script's two-masters-never-down comment is limited to the case where the PID is readable. Later-joined control planes: 02-join-control-plane.sh reads kubeadm-config from master-1 (unreadable -> refuses), fetches oidc-ca.crt when it references oidc-ca-file, installs it root:root 0644 before kubeadm join and refuses to join without it; on Kakao distribute-join-kakao.sh makes the same decision on the operator host and stages /tmp/oidc-ca.crt or stops. verify-cluster.sh handles the v1beta3 map form and SKIPs with an explicit reason for unknown apiVersion, RBAC/API errors, missing yq or an empty config.

Opus review of PR #521 (head 555e3206) = FAIL, HIGH: with --oidc-ca-file in kubeadm-config, a control plane joined later renders an apiserver that cannot start, because kubeadm join copies only kubeadm's own certs and 02-join-control-plane.sh did not copy oidc-ca.crt; the original change claimed the later-join case was fixed, but it turned 'later master lacks OIDC' into 'later master crashloops'. Corrected: the join path installs the CA first and refuses without it (Vagrant and Kakao), R297 pins both with mutations, the helper header, docs and lessons-log now state the prerequisite. LOW findings also fixed: the verify gate handles v1beta3 and reports explicit SKIP reasons.

events.scope: Behavioural harness R297 (stub kubectl with a file-backed kubeadm-config, real yq merge on v1beta4 and v1beta3 samples) with 12 mutations, the extended R290b harness, the R290 static check with its mutations, and the full static suite. NOT covered: a real later control-plane join (02-join-control-plane.sh is covered by static wiring checks only, not executed), any live cluster - a real kubeadm upgrade apply|node (or --dry-run) regenerating the manifest from the patched ClusterConfiguration, the real kubeadm-config shape on Kakao and Vagrant, RBAC for the patch, and the verify-cluster.sh gate against a live cluster.

Nothing is verified on a cluster; a real kubeadm upgrade and a real later join are the open checks.

Complete within repository scope; #505 item 1 stays open until a real kubeadm upgrade (or kubeadm upgrade node --dry-run) on a cluster shows the regenerated kube-apiserver manifest keeps the seven flags.
